title: Aromatic Dense Indian Broccoli Biryani
description: A spicy, plant-based biryani that blends broccoli, basmati rice, and aromatic spices for a dense, adventurous American twist.
instructions: Rinse 200 g of basmati rice under cold water until water runs clear, then soak for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, bring 400 ml vegetable stock to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the soaked rice to the simmering stock, cover, lower heat, and cook until the rice is al dente, about 12 minutes, then set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat and add sliced onion, sautéing until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, minced ginger, and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Mix in ground cumin and ground coriander, and sprinkle chili powder, turmeric, and garam masala; cook for another 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet, tossing to coat with the spice mixture, and continue cooking for 5 minutes until the broccoli is tender yet still crisp.
Pour in the plant-based yogurt, stirring to combine, and reduce heat to low, letting the mixture simmer gently for 3 minutes to meld flavors.

Transfer the spiced broccoli and yogurt mixture into the pot of cooked rice, fold gently to distribute evenly, and cover with a tight-fitting lid, cooking over low heat for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving hot.
